### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] Every exposed operation has one persona-language case and one SKILL.md.
- [ ] Exactly two synthetic knowledge files are present.
- [ ] Responses state the relevant human approval or review boundary.
- [ ] No operation claims an external write, communication, commitment, or protected decision.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate user-approved step.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
